title: Demonic Forge Ritual
description: A red demonic blacksmith with glowing green hair and horns stands at a glowing anvil in a dark ritual chamber, hammering a piece of metal. The scene features swirling red, green and blue energy vortexes above, patches of bright green grass growing from stone blocks, scattered red petals, an open book, and small demonic creatures on the stone floor.
